title: CRATE — Containerizing Exploits (Honours Project)
description: Containerized 8 CVE exploit/code pairs to analyze compiler security hardening in GCC. Built a reproducible framework using Docker to automate vulnerable builds from source for exploit testing. Awarded a First-Class grade.

title: Melanoma Classification (Multi-GPU Deep Learning)
description: Trained and evaluated vision transformer models (ViT-L, Swin-B) and EfficientNet variants. Developed a distributed training framework for multi-GPU workloads on Slurm clusters, improving training efficiency by ~40%.

title: pwdtools — GPU Security & Cryptography Toolkit
description: Built a password security analysis and hash verification suite utilizing Apple's Metal framework for GPU acceleration and high-throughput cryptographic operations.
